title: Stop file-sync conflict copies from reaching commits
description: From TASK-3.10: iCloud 'name 2.ext' sync-conflict copies appeared in the working tree (the project lives under ~/Documents), broke typecheck and the gate, and one under backlog/ was committed by the doit commit step. Real failure. Options: move the repo out of an iCloud-synced folder (user action), ignore '* 2.*' patterns in .gitignore, and/or a repo check that fails on such files.

nodes.title: Stop file-sync conflict copies from reaching commits

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a file named like 'x 2.ts' or 'doc-100 … 2.md' appears in the working tree, When tests/lint or the CI check run, Then the run fails naming the file (or git ignores it via .gitignore), so it cannot be committed
Given the guidance in docs, When a developer reads it, Then it says the repo must not live in an iCloud-synced folder (Desktop & Documents) and how to move it

implementationNotes: No dependency: the guard protects every later commit; run it next so parked/following stories don't pick up sync copies.
